description: This file contains URL parsing, normalization, matching, and associated utility functions used for URL handling within a software project. It includes URL validation, normalization, pattern matching, and configuration integration related to URL processing.

methods.name: int append_normalized_escapes(struct strbuf * buf,const char * from,size_t from_len,const char * esc_extra,const char * esc_ok)
methods.description: Appends characters from a source string to a buffer, escaping characters as needed based on provided rules, normalizing percent-encodings, and handling extra escape characters.

methods.name: const char * end_of_token(const char * s,int c,size_t n)
methods.description: Finds the end position of a token in a string given a delimiter.

methods.name: int match_host(const struct url_info * url_info,const struct url_info * pattern_info)
methods.description: Matches the host components of two URL info structures, considering wildcards and IPv6 literals.

methods.name: char * url_normalize_1(const char * url,struct url_info * out_info,char allow_globs)
methods.description: Normalizes a full URL according to RFC 3986 rules, including case conversion, escaping, path resolution, port normalization, and handling IPv6 literals.

methods.name: char * url_normalize(const char * url,struct url_info * out_info)
methods.description: Public interface for normalizing a URL, calls url_normalize_1 with globs disabled.

methods.name: size_t url_match_prefix(const char * url,const char * url_prefix,size_t url_prefix_len)
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches a prefix, considering boundary conditions like implicit slashes.

methods.name: int match_urls(const struct url_info * url,const struct url_info * url_prefix,struct urlmatch_item * match)
methods.description: Checks whether a URL matches a URL prefix based on scheme, host, port, and path components.

methods.name: int cmp_matches(const struct urlmatch_item * a,const struct urlmatch_item * b)
methods.description: Compares two URL match items based on host match length, path match length, and user match status.

methods.name: int urlmatch_config_entry(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Processes URL pattern entries in configuration, attempting to match URLs based on the pattern's scope and updating internal match data structures.

methods.name: void urlmatch_config_release(struct urlmatch_config * config)
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a URL match configuration.
